# Semiprime arithmetic

[All theorem families](README.md) · [Family metadata](../theorem-explorer/metadata.json)

Semiprime factor-location identities, exact multiplication networks, recursive tensor acquisition and verified machine components. The complete deterministic subexponential bit-complexity theorem remains open; research probes are optional.

**3160 modules.** Source links open the definitions, hypotheses and proofs.
